source: S500 native RS-FISH N5 s0 source, canonical authoritative post-RSFISH xyz from Section500 Stage556; R9 detected spots are post-correction but tested against native raw acquisition
sampling: Each gene per-file proportional random source rows; quality-filter sample at least 18 px XY and 8 z from N5 block boundaries for paired 31x31 pixel neighborhoods
measure: 3x3 local intensity peak minus median 31x31 background; compare same image at pixel +12,+12, local MAD as normalizer
scope: This estimates whether listed detected spot coordinates coincide with bright raw image structure, NOT specificity relative to all non-spot voxels and NOT the recall/FN rate. Does NOT prove correct spatial assignment to R1 cells across round registration.
